summary: Confirmed all 40 requested estimates after reading the complete main-paper and supplement markdown conversions, including appendices. Checked all cited pages directly with PyMuPDF: main PDF pp. 2-5 and 7-8; supplement pp. 5-6, 10, 12, 14, 21 and 77. Recovered Tables S1, S3, S4, S11, S12 and S13 with find_tables() and verified outcome columns, assigned-condition contrasts, coefficients, standard errors, control statistics, significance bounds and applicable F tests. Writer counts, full-model observation counts and all requested codes are supported. The reported preregistration quotation failures are false positives: supplement p. 77 has a corrupted text layer, but its rendered page confirms all three quoted passages verbatim. The conditional combined-arm primary analysis, component and specification robustness tests, and absence of similarity outcomes from the preregistration are correctly documented. The supplement_changes log contains no replacement of an existing numerical value. Main-PDF similarity coefficients 4.29 and 4.11 remain unchanged; the supplement values 4.288 and 4.105 are only noted. No extraction problems found.
